newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kmart buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kmart buy reiterated.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co Inc said Monday it reiterated its buy recommendation on most of Kmart Corp's bonds because of the attractive fundamentals and yields.

--Gruntal noted in a report that the retailer completed repayment of its $1.2 billion three-year term loan well ahead of its scheduled due date. The loan was part of Kmart's refinancing in mid-1996 and was not planned to be fully paid until 1999.
--Gruntal also repeated its hold on Kmart's 7.75 percent convertible predferred stock.
